content.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
content.description: Meta has detailed TLX, its Triton Low-Level Extensions that add warp-group, barrier, TMA and cluster control to Python Triton kernels. It runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell and AMD MI350 GPUs. The post Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD appeared first on MarkTechPost .
